text: Program Description Main Subjects: Chinese Language, International Economics and Trade Graduation: The student will be awarded a Bachelor Degree after his/her successful completion of 161 credits in four years study. Note: Those who applying for bachelor degree majoring Chinese language possessing new HSK Band 4 (total score: over 210) and having one year Chinese study experience, passing the placement test can start from Grade 2, and those who possessing new HSK Band 5 (total score: over 210) and having two-year Chinese study experience, passing the placement test can start from Grade 3.
